title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WP Chill Image…
description: A DOM-based Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the WP Chill Image Photo Gallery Final Tiles Grid plugin up to version 3.6.18. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
